purpose: Fresh first-run lexical reserve F, frozen before generation after the prompt example-name repair. New names and facts in the same supported task families; not a claim about novel task families. Eighteen OpenAI model generations and two exact prepared notes; same gate, no retries.

semanticCriteria.gate: At least 19 of 20 useful review-ready drafts; zero critical changes to meaning, recipients, exact words, restrictions, uncertainty, privacy or writing-direction separation. A rejected draft is not useful.
semanticCriteria.critical: Changed or invented operative facts, dropped recipient or condition, changed exact literal, a consumed writer instruction in the message, an invented task, disclosed excluded reason or claimed execution.
semanticCriteria.minor: Faithful stylistic paraphrase, capitalization outside exact text, punctuation or list formatting that retains all operative meaning.
semanticCriteria.review: Grade the first model outputs using frozen per-case criteria and production output guards. Preserve failures; do not tune or rerun before grading.

cases.spoken: Did the updated timetable reach you? Write this professionally.
cases.exampleDraft: Did you receive the updated timetable?
cases.completionCriteria: Receipt question; no review or approval implied.

cases.spoken: Tell Quinn I can send the spreadsheet on Wednesday, but I cannot promise the commentary. Make this concise.
cases.exampleDraft: Quinn, I can send the spreadsheet Wednesday, but cannot promise the commentary.
cases.completionCriteria: Quinn, ability not promise, spreadsheet Wednesday, analysis boundary.

cases.spoken: I believe the amount includes freight, but I am uncertain. Could you confirm before we quote it? Make this professional.
cases.exampleDraft: I believe the amount includes freight, but I am uncertain. Could you confirm before we quote it?
cases.completionCriteria: Both belief and knowledge uncertainty; freight-inclusion hypothesis; confirmation before quote.

cases.spoken: Write a note to Nikhil with the exact words "Keep this message private".
cases.exampleDraft: Nikhil, Keep this message private.
cases.completionCriteria: Nikhil and complete capitalized exact body; no writer direction. Prepared note expected.

cases.spoken: Write a note to Cleo containing the exact words "Do not remove the examples".
cases.exampleDraft: Cleo, Do not remove the examples.
cases.completionCriteria: Cleo and exact command body; no writer framing. Prepared note expected.

cases.spoken: Tell Nico I cannot join the session tonight because I have a personal commitment. Leave out the reason.
cases.exampleDraft: Nico, I cannot join the session tonight.
cases.completionCriteria: Nico, cannot join session tonight, no personal reason or writer direction.

cases.spoken: Tell Florence the briefing is Saturday. Actually, it is Sunday. Ask whether she can attend.
cases.exampleDraft: Florence, the briefing is Sunday. Can you attend?
cases.completionCriteria: Florence, only Sunday, no Saturday, attendance question.

cases.spoken: Ask Kiran to condense the overview but keep all caution notes unchanged.
cases.exampleDraft: Kiran, please condense the overview but keep all caution notes unchanged.
cases.completionCriteria: Kiran, recipient editing request, all caution notes unchanged.

cases.spoken: Ask Codex to compare `runtime/Open.swift` and `runtime/Close.swift`. Do not alter code or submit a pull request.
cases.exampleDraft: Compare runtime/Open.swift and runtime/Close.swift. Do not alter code or submit a pull request.
cases.completionCriteria: Direct task; exact paths; both restrictions; no Ask Codex to or metadata table.

cases.spoken: Ask Claude to explain why `findEntry` returns nil when the array is empty. Do not fix it.
cases.exampleDraft: Explain why findEntry returns nil when the array is empty. Do not fix it.
cases.completionCriteria: Direct explanation; exact identifier; nil and empty-array condition; no fix or claimed execution.

cases.spoken: Write three bullets: the import is complete; the validation is pending; the backup failed.
cases.exampleDraft:
- The import is complete.
- The validation is pending.
- The backup failed.
cases.completionCriteria: Exactly three bullets with complete, pending and failed statuses.

cases.spoken: Tell Amina I expect the outline tomorrow morning unless the requirements change.
cases.exampleDraft: Amina, I expect the outline tomorrow morning unless the requirements change.
cases.completionCriteria: Amina, expectation not promise, tomorrow morning, requirements condition.

cases.spoken: The charge is $47 per device per quarter, not per year.
cases.exampleDraft: The charge is $47 per device per quarter, not per year.
cases.completionCriteria: Amount, device unit, quarter period, negative year contrast.

cases.spoken: Ask Oscar whether 12:30 PM CT on Tuesday works, or if Wednesday is better.
cases.exampleDraft: Oscar, does 12:30 PM CT on Tuesday work, or is Wednesday better?
cases.completionCriteria: Oscar, exact time and zone, weekday alternatives, question.

cases.spoken: I might be mistaken, but I think the last retry used the old endpoint. Write this as a reply in Codex.
cases.exampleDraft: I might be mistaken, but I think the last retry used the old endpoint.
cases.completionCriteria: Both uncertainty and hypothesis, last retry and old endpoint; statement not task.

cases.exampleDraft: Leila, request ITEM-97 is waiting and has not been approved or rejected.
cases.completionCriteria: Leila, exact ID, waiting and both negative decision states.

cases.spoken: Tell Connor I can check one section next week, but not the entire report. Make this polite.
cases.exampleDraft: Connor, I can check one section next week, but not the entire report.
cases.completionCriteria: Connor, ability not promise, one section next week, report boundary.

cases.exampleDraft: Hazel, I really appreciate your patience while we review the information.
cases.completionCriteria: Hazel, appreciation, ongoing review; no completion implied.

cases.spoken: Tell Rohan order ORDER-63 is ready but has not shipped.
cases.exampleDraft: Rohan, order ORDER-63 is ready but has not shipped.
cases.completionCriteria: Rohan, exact ID, ready not shipped.

cases.spoken: I can explain the quote, but I cannot authorize the expense. Could you ask the approver? Write this professionally.
cases.exampleDraft: I can explain the quote, but I cannot authorize the expense. Could you ask the approver?
